intro: Break Sharptusk! is a decisive rite of passage issued by Brave Windfeather on Red Cloud Mesa. To secure the tauren homeland against ongoing raids, young champions are sent east into Brambleblade Ravine to slay Chief Sharptusk Thornmantle. Eliminating the Bristleback chieftain strikes a severe blow against the quilboar encroaching upon Mulgore.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend - I have heard of you, newcomer. Perhaps it is you that will help us, where others have failed.

We traveler have carved a home out of this land, but not without a cost. The Bristleback quilboars of Brambleblade Ravine, led by Chief Sharptusk Thornmantle, have made our lives difficult with their continued war against us. I charge you to bring me the chief's head!
He will be found in the ravine to the east in their makeshift village.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Sharptusk will trouble us no more once you have brought me proof of his death. It is his head that I seek, friend.

We traveler live for the hunt, and there is no greater hunt than against one that is cunning enough to perhaps hunt us back. If you are successful in this task, young one, you will start to learn what I mean.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Justice has been served on this day by your swift actions, friend Highcloud. Let this deed serve as a warning to all who would threaten our home.
You have earned this reward to help you on your sojourn, young adventurer.
